name: Korean
description: The gayageum, the Korean twelve-stringed zither, plucked with the fingers.
credit: Sounds put together for HO[LO] (CC0): HO[LO] Desk's built-in synths and effects. Each pack keeps its own licence and credit.

source.note: No audio of its own: its sounds play the packs it requires and HO[LO] Desk’s built-in synths.

sounds.name: Gayageum
sounds.note: Warm and round, with a deep, slow vibrato.

sounds.name: Gayageum, Deep Vibrato
sounds.note: The left hand pressing and shaking the string (nonghyeon), wide and slow.

sounds.name: Gayageum, Bright
sounds.note: A brighter pluck with less vibrato, for quick figures.
